integrity: A self-contained proof covers every finite graph and the infinite stochastic limits; 81 finite exact tests and two expectation calculations provide corroboration, not proof of asymptotics. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Simple undirected independent-edge graph, symmetric unit value for incident goods, fixed real window parameter, external nonnegative subsidies and global envy including isolated agents. Stochastic law is the contribution; prior deterministic component criteria and isolated-agent payment examples acknowledged. Publication priority not independently certified.
title: Poisson-to-Bernoulli subsidy amplification in sparse random graphical fair division
